items.summary: Bernadette Wilson, who has appealed to other Republicans to consolidate around her party’s top finisher, will be one of four finalists on the ranked-choice ballot in November.

items.title: A Surrogate Fled to Texas to Avoid an Abortion. Now She Wants Custody of the Baby.
items.summary: A surrogate refused to have an abortion after the fetus was diagnosed with a serious heart problem. She fled to Texas and had the child. Now she wants a judge to give custody to her instead of the biological parents.
